description: This file contains unit tests for the TimezonesAPI class within the OrangeHRM attendance plugin, specifically testing the retrieval of timezone data via API endpoints and related functionalities.

classes.name: TimezonesAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the functionality of the TimezonesAPI class, including the 'getAll' API method and placeholder tests for delete and create operations.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' method of TimezonesAPI, verifying correct data retrieval and response when filtering is applied.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides data for the 'testGetAll' method, with special handling for PHP version >= 7.4.29 to modify timezone data.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Ensures that the delete method of the API throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for delete are not implemented and throw exceptions.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Ensures that the create endpoint is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Checks that validation rules for create are not implemented.
